facts.fact: The text of the Kenya Communications (Electronic Transactions) Regulations, 2009, made by the Minister under section 83R of the Kenya Communications (Amendment) Act 2009, sets licensing, operating and liability rules for certification service providers; the held text leaves its legal notice number and making date blank.

The Regulations require certification service providers to tell subscribers that an advanced electronic signature has the same legal effect as a handwritten one, under the 2009 Amendment Act to the Kenya Communications Act 1998; the held text is unnumbered and undated.
